messages:
mike_s: Heads-up — Red team booked a 48h validation window next Tue for a hosted->dedicated routing scenario. Need quick alignment on access, KMS, and audit expectations. :eyes:

tara: timeline? who needs what access exactly?

mike_s: Window starts 2025-07-15 09:00 UTC. They'll exercise cross-tenant routing fallbacks, ephemeral key access for model artifacts, and a few simulated data-exfil flows.

josh_m: For RBAC I suggest ephemeral roles scoped to the red-team project only, timeboxed to the 48h window. No service-account sharing. We should use our existing role template: `redteam_assessor_v1` with only read/list on S3 buckets and describe on KMS.

alice_g: Agree. Also require MFA for the sign-in bounce and record token exchanges. Can we gate via Okta range for the assessment CIDR?

kevin_ops: Okta IP restriction is doable for the scheduled window. We'll spin up an ephemeral bastion with session recording. I'll add the CIDR and create a short-lived role mapping.

mike_s: Quick Q on KMS: red-team needs to validate key-wrapping and ability to request decrypt for cached artifacts. Are we comfortable giving them DescribeKey and GenerateDataKey permissions?

josh_m: They should not get Decrypt on production root keys. Pattern: create a delegated key alias `alias/redteam/validate` that is bound to a key policy allowing GenerateDataKey but Deny Decrypt except when used by the dedicated-validation pool role. Link it to a staging CMK separate from prod.

tara: Good. Also need to document how we'll revoke the alias after the window. Kept ephemeral for 72h post-window.

alice_g: Audit/logging checklist — make sure CloudTrail (or equivalent) has management, data, and S3 object-level logging on. Export to the SIEM stream (kafka://ingest-01.redwood.local:9092) and retain at least 90 days for the test evidence.

kevin_ops: I'll enable S3 data events for the buckets we expose and ensure the KMS key usage events are forwarded. We'll also turn on API Gateway access logs for any public endpoints the red team hits.

sre-bot: Deploy scheduled: ephemeral-bastion v2.1 scheduled for 2025-07-15T08:30Z by kevin_ops — status: queued.

mike_s: Remediation tracking — create issues in SECBOARD project. Use label `redteam-2025-07` and severity triage in the first 12h. Who owns triage?

josh_m: I'll own first triage sweep. Triage will bucket into: (1) auth/privilege escalation, (2) data exfil, (3) telemetry gaps. Create template with required evidence: logs, presigned downloads, timeline.

tara: Can we have a downloadable bundle for assessors to post findings? Something like `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://reports.redwood.internal/assessments/4923/download` that drops into a secured S3 with presigned URL.

kevin_ops: We have a small internal endpoint for that. I'll add `assessment.download` scope to the temporary role and require the file to be encrypted with the `alias/redteam/validate` key.

alice_g: Incident response plan — if red-team triggers a true-high severity (pwned sentinel), we default to "observe and contain" for 2h and call incident commander (ic@redwood.com). Do we want to allow active blocking?

mike_s: Decision: no live blocking without IC signoff. We want to capture full telemetry. But on confirmed data exfil, we may cut network egress for the test tenant. Documented in the playbook.

josh_m: Also note: ensure all model-serving logs include request-id/route/model-version. Add a quick patch to the logging middleware to include `x-request-id` in every log line for the validation window. I'll open a small PR.

kevin_ops: PR link: https://git.redwood/sys/serving/-/merge_requests/999 — I'll queue a canary deploy to staging, then prod canary for the window.

alice_g: One more: audit proofs. We'll snapshot KMS access logs and S3 object versions at 2025-07-14T23:59Z and again at window close. Need someone to attest to the snapshots.

mike_s: Tara will attest pre-window, Josh will attest post-window.

tara: happy to.

josh_m: I'll do the post attestation and upload the hash to SECBOARD ticket.

kevin_ops: Action items I'll take: 1) create ephemeral bastion + session recording 2) provision `alias/redteam/validate` CMK 3) enable S3 data events + CloudTrail forward to SIEM 4) enable assessment.download scope. ETA EOD Fri.

mike_s: Action items for sec-eng: 1) josh: triage template + logging middleware PR 2) tara: pre-window attestation and Okta CIDR 3) alice: update IR playbook with test rules.

sre-bot: Reminder: please add all new tickets to the milestone `redteam-2025-07` — auto-check in 24h.

mike_s: Thanks all. If anyone spots a policy gap post-setup ping here and we'll do a quick sync on Mon. :white_check_mark:
